description.en: Shows one tutorial page: the image data/tutorial/<_imgFileName>_<LG>.xa slides in from the right while the sound _strm plays. After 60 frames the "next" arrow appears and the function waits for A, B or a touch (BtnImageNext). With _decide it then plays the confirm sound (sys_001). Finally the page slides out to the left and is deleted.
Event sound played when the page appears.
true to play the confirm sound when the player moves on.

examples.case: How ShowTutorial2 uses it (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut)
